analyst.text: Giannis Antetokounmpo is in a public spat with his old Bucks coach Doc Rivers, who questioned his basketball IQ. Giannis is listed day-to-day with a wrist sprain, not ruled out. He has also said the Heat need to rebuild trust. Utah have lost eight straight with Keyonte George, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic out. Rookie Darryn Peterson is coming off a career-high 26. The motivation edge leans toward Miami, but check Giannis's status before tip-off.
